subject: deadline
fact: The party has one week to organize the Upper Temple before Barkinar returns.
source_quote: A week.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: One Week Deadline
fact: Barkinar gave the party one week to organize the Upper Temple under their new command — a ticking clock that transforms their mission from destruction to administration.

subject: one week deadline
fact: The Greater Temple has given the party exactly one week to organize the Upper Temple — a temporal anchor that transforms their insurgency into a bureaucratic obligation and sets the next phase of the story in motion.
source_quote: The upper temple should look organized when he came back through these steps. A week.

subject: Session Anchor
fact: The events occur immediately after the Fire Temple’s collapse and the treasury’s exodus. The Water Temple’s infiltration is the next scheduled action — arriving on schedule, as predicted.
source_quote: We did that. Not by accident. We took bribes... and pointed three armies at each other until they marched. One does not simply... end up the rightful lords of anything. We ended up here anyway.

subject: session date
fact: The infiltration occurred during a session where the group was actively engaged in a mission to assassinate Belsornig and infiltrate the Water Temple.
source_quote: So we would smash the door... The plan died when Zinnia hit the door...

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Session timestamp
fact: The events occur immediately after the defeat of the wraith in the Earth Temple and before the entry into the Air Temple; no calendar date is given, but the temporal sequence is continuous and urgent, with no rest between encounters.

subject: sundown of yesterday
fact: The four named threats — Romag, Hartsch, Alrrem, and Belsornig — were eliminated by sundown the previous day, establishing the Greater Temple’s operational speed and the party’s own actions as already cataloged and absorbed into its larger plan.
source_quote: Problems I had on a list yesterday morning, and four problems gone by sundown.

subject: Two Weeks Ago
fact: Two weeks ago, Kelno set out the second chair and began preparing for the player group’s arrival. This marks the moment he recognized their potential as a wild card after Romag’s death, and decided to align with them for survival.
source_quote: A little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: two weeks ago
fact: Two weeks ago, Kelno set out the second chair in his chamber and waited for the group's arrival.
source_quote: a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: Two Weeks Ago
fact: Two weeks before Zephyr’s arrival, Kelno set out the second chair, anticipating the rise of a new power; this temporal marker confirms his long-term planning and the inevitability of the war that followed.
source_quote: A little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: Alrrem's cremation
fact: Alrrem is already on his pyre when Dren reports to Sequoia.
source_quote: Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Assassination of Belsornig
fact: Belsornig was killed mid-reading by Zephyr using Kelno’s Dagger of Venom, while Sequoia and Zinnia eliminated his guards; the entire operation lasted less than ten seconds, executed with surgical silence.

subject: assassination of Belsornig
fact: Belsornig, Prophet of Water, was killed by Zephyr using Kelno's Dagger of Venom after the party infiltrated his chamber.
source_quote: I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home.

subject: assassination of Belsornig's guards
fact: Two cult fanatics guarding Belsornig were killed by Sequoia and Zinnia before Zephyr struck the Prophet.
source_quote: Sequoia and Zinnia took the first one apart. The second was mine.

subject: Assassination of Hartsch
fact: Hartsch, a key leader of the Fire Temple, was assassinated by Belsornig’s agents, triggering a cascade of violence that allowed Zephyr’s group to position themselves as the dominant power in the temple complex.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: Assassination of Hartsch
fact: Hartsch, head of the Air Temple, was assassinated by agents who entered through the north service hall. The attack was planned but not executed by Kelno — he received a warning note from the enemy instructing them to leave the player group alive. This event triggered the power vacuum the group now occupies.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar acknowledged the deaths of Romag, Hartsch, Alrrem, and Belsornig as completed problems.
source_quote: Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig," Barkinar said. "Problems I had on a list yesterday morning, and four problems gone by sundown.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar instructed Zephyr and Zinnia to organize the Upper Temple within a week.
source_quote: A week to organize the house. The house we came to burn.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar smiled at Kelno, revealing he had been watching him for two weeks.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that. A man who smiles at the prisoner he has been watching from hidden passages for two weeks is a man who already knows more than he is saying.

subject: Barkinar's assessment
fact: Barkinar assessed the party's efficiency in eliminating four cult leaders and offered them a week to organize the temple.
source_quote: Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig... four problems gone by sundown. You will forgive me if I'm impressed.

subject: Barkinar's departure
fact: Barkinar left the chamber after issuing orders, without further engagement, signaling his confidence in control.
source_quote: Before any of us spoke, Barkinar turned. He said something quiet to one of his ogres, and walked back down into the dark.

subject: Battle for the Water Temple
fact: With the Fire Temple leader dead and the Earth Temple leader removed, Zephyr’s group prepares to strike the Water Temple, now lightly guarded, to complete their takeover of the temple complex.
source_quote: He pointed us toward the Water Temple — lightly guarded now, he observed, as good a time as any to strike.

subject: Belsornig's assassination attempt
fact: An assassination plot against Hartsch is carried out by Belsornig's agents via the north service hall.
source_quote: Belsornig — *by the cannon of the crushing wave*, the man liked the name — the assassination plot against Hartsch, two men through the north service hall, the bar that should've been left unset.

subject: Belsornig's treasury removal
fact: Belsornig is removing his treasury via the south route as the temple war escalates.
source_quote: Belsornig pulling his treasury out the south route.

subject: bluff acceptance
fact: The guards behind the door accepted the courier bluff because the news of Alrrem’s death and the Obsidian Edge’s threat was credible.
source_quote: They're dead, then, with Alrrem dying, and those fools… All that remains is for us to defeat those pompous asses known as the Obsidian Edge.

subject: bluff with Kelno credentials
fact: The party successfully deceived the guards by claiming to be messengers from Kelno bearing news of an assassination.
source_quote: We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination, a letter, a coin to prove it.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believed he was being removed from the fight while others went into the temple to complete the work.
source_quote: I was not in front. I was not even in the room. They were going through the door and I was going up.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer felt the wraith's death as a personal victory, even as others carried him away.
source_quote: The wraith was dead. I held onto that. Whatever else was happening to me... the wraith was dead and I had been the one to kill it.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer killed the wraith twice using holy radiance, and felt the outrage of it.
source_quote: Twice it had laughed at the holy power I called down in His name. Twice the holy radiance had hit the wraith and simply ceased — the way divine light ceases when it finds nothing that recognizes it, and twice I had felt the outrage of it — the warrior of St. Cuthbert who could not turn a thing that should not exist.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer tried to refuse being carried and told the mercenaries to unhand him.
source_quote: *Unhand me, you creatures.* The words came out, or didn't.

subject: Calmer's injury
fact: Calmer is severely injured during the battle with the wraith and is rendered unable to stand without assistance.
source_quote: with nothing left in me but reflex and the body's last argument against lying down

subject: Calmer's removal from the battlefield
fact: Calmer was dragged out of the Earth Temple after defeating the wraith, incapacitated by injury and psychological collapse; his removal was ordered by Dren's mercenaries under the guise of protection, but it effectively exiled him from the decisive phase of the mission.

subject: Civil War Initiation
fact: The player group has unintentionally initiated a civil war among the temples by eliminating key leaders and inserting themselves as the fourth power. Kelno confirms they are now the victors by default. The group has no prior knowledge of the rules — but now understands that the winner of the conflict will lead the lesser temples.
source_quote: He asked if anyone had explained what starting a civil war actually meant. They hadn't. I hadn't known there were rules.

subject: Death of Romag
fact: Romag, the former head of the Earth Temple, was killed, likely by the player group’s actions or inactions. His death, combined with Hartsch’s, left the Earth Temple unclaimed — allowing the group to insert a cleric posing as an earth cultist and claim legitimacy as the fourth temple.
source_quote: We let Romag get killed.

subject: Defeat of the wraith
fact: Calmer invoked holy radiance twice and destroyed a wraith in the Earth Temple, but the act left him physically and spiritually wounded, triggering a psychological unraveling that culminated in his removal from the fight.

subject: door breach by Zinnia
fact: Zinnia finally breached the west door after two failed attempts, initiating the confrontation.
source_quote: I set myself, and I hit it. It didn't give. I bounced.

subject: door failure
fact: Zinnia's two attempts to break the west door failed, alerting the guards and forcing a change in strategy.
source_quote: It didn't give. I bounced. The door held and threw me back... Twice. The same flat, jarring nothing, twice.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren reported that Belsornig’s people were at the captain’s door and Alrrem was on his pyre.
source_quote: "Belsornig's people are at his door. He's screaming for you." ... "Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren was ordered to stay behind with Calmer and the mercenaries to protect him.
source_quote: "Take your mercenaries and stay back," Zephyr landed on, finally.

subject: Dren’s Departure
fact: Dren left with his two men, returning to Calmer’s side — not because he was ordered, but because he chose to. His loyalty is his command.
source_quote: He gathered his two men off the wall, gave me one last look — the look that still thought I was the reasonable one — and they headed out, back toward the stairs, back toward Calmer.

subject: Dren's reassignment
fact: Dren and his two mercenaries are ordered to stay behind and guard Calmer upstairs.
source_quote: "Take your mercenaries and stay back," Zephyr landed on, finally.

subject: Entry into the Air Temple
fact: Zephyr, Zinnia, and Sequoia entered the Air Temple through a hidden passage, leaving Calmer behind; the temple's lower levels are barricaded and hostile, and Zephyr intends to exploit the internal conflict among the starving prophets to seize control.

subject: false cleric leadership
fact: The party allowed the Greater Temple to believe Calmer was their leader, using the misperception as tactical cover.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course.

subject: false identity assumption
fact: The Greater Temple assumed Calmer was the leader of the party, a misperception the party allowed to persist.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course.

subject: false messenger identity
fact: The party used the false identity of messengers from Kelno to gain entry to the Water Temple.
source_quote: We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination, a letter, a coin to prove it.

subject: Gong of the Temple
fact: A deep gong rang after Belsornig’s death, signaling a ritual acknowledgment by the temple that leadership had changed hands — a supernatural confirmation of the party’s new status, whether they wanted it or not.

subject: gong resonance
fact: A deep gong rang after Belsornig’s death, signaling a change in power within the temple.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level.

subject: gong signal
fact: The gong that rang after Belsornig's death signaled a shift in power to the Greater Temple.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level.

subject: gong sounding
fact: A deep gong rings through the Water Temple after Belsornig's death, signaling a change of control.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level.

subject: Hartsch's death
fact: Hartsch is assassinated by agents who reached his antechamber an hour before Kelno's meeting.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: house organization
fact: A week was spent organizing the house that was originally intended to be burned.
source_quote: The house we came to burn needed a week to organize.

subject: Infiltration of the Water Temple
fact: The party’s forced breach of the west door failed, prompting a shift to deception; Zephyr’s bluff as messengers bearing news of Belsornig’s death succeeded, allowing them to enter unchallenged and eliminate the guards before they could react.

subject: infiltration of the Water Temple
fact: The west door was breached by force after two failed attempts, leading to a successful bluff using false courier credentials.
source_quote: We would smash the door. Splash through it. Take them while their hands were still finding their weapons.

subject: Infiltration of the Water Temple
fact: Zephyr and the party moved silently through the Water Temple hall without triggering any defenses — the gargoyles, the idol, and the temple itself did not react. The infiltration was flawless.
source_quote: We crossed the whole of it and nothing stirred. Clean. Gotcha.

subject: infiltration of the west door
fact: The infiltration began with failed physical breaches, followed by false identities, then a successful deception using news of an assassination, leading to the door opening and the cultists being caught unawares.
source_quote: Zinnia hit the door and the door hit back... We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination... the door opened. The bluff held so clean we didn't just get in — we caught them flat-footed.

subject: Kelno's offer
fact: Kelno offers Zephyr control of his goblins, informants, and the throne in exchange for becoming his number two.
source_quote: Or I could walk out with him as my number two. His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine. His little office, his.

subject: killing of Belsornig
fact: Belsornig was killed without resistance after the infiltrators silently crossed the chamber and struck simultaneously — Sequoia opened him, Zinnia burned the water from him, and the infiltrator delivered the final blow.
source_quote: Sequoia opened him up. Zinnia charged and burned the water out of him. I came in last, missed the first, found the second exactly where I wanted it.

subject: recognition of hidden forces
fact: The party realized that the Greater Temple had maintained permanent, unseen forces on every level of the temple complex — including areas they believed were empty — revealing that their entire campaign had been conducted within a house that was never truly theirs, nor ever truly unoccupied.
source_quote: We had been operating inside a house that was never empty. We had simply never opened the right doors.

subject: Removal of Calmer from the Battlefield
fact: Calmer was carried away from the Air Temple by Dren’s mercenaries at Zephyr’s indirect behest, ensuring he would not interfere with the final moves of the war — a decision that preserved Calmer’s life but removed him from agency.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't with us. Deeply injured, parked with Dren's mercenaries somewhere behind a curtain so he wouldn't get himself killed...

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia declared they were the victors, recognizing their strategic dominance over the temple conflict.
source_quote: "We are the victors," Sequoia said.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia mocked the silence of the group by saying they sit 'silently and menacingly' to provoke Kelno.
source_quote: "Sit down," I said, which made no sense as a reply, and I sat anyway. ... "Yeah," Sequoia said. "We sit there silently and menacingly."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia noted that Kelno had prepared the second chair two weeks ago, anticipating their arrival.
source_quote: A little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old. He'd put the chair out two weeks ago and sat across from it, waiting for us.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia understood that the party had engineered the war to position themselves as the inevitable victors.
source_quote: We took bribes from the Fire Temple, sold a chimera, knifed Romag at his own table, and pointed three armies at each other until they marched.

subject: Slaying of the Wraith
fact: Calmer used divine radiance to kill a wraith twice, each time the power failing as it encountered no recognition — an act that drained him physically and spiritually, leaving him injured and unable to continue in combat.
source_quote: The wraith was dead... I had been the one to kill it. Twice it had laughed at the holy power I called down in His name.

subject: Summoning by Barkinar
fact: After the temple’s fall, the party was summoned by Barkinar through a hidden network of bugbears; they were confronted with overwhelming force and forced to accept control of the Upper Temple under the Greater Temple’s authority within one week.

subject: summons to the Greater Temple
fact: Barkinar summoned the party to the lower chamber, where Calmer was assumed to be the leader, and the party was given one week to organize the temple.
source_quote: Come down, bring your puppet master if he is alive. We should talk.

subject: summons to the Greater Temple
fact: The party was summoned by the Greater Temple under false assumptions of their hierarchy, forced into a meeting where their actions were already known and cataloged. They were presented with an inventory of holdings and given one week to organize the Upper Temple — transforming them from insurgents into administrators under a hidden regime.
source_quote: Be careful of the people downstairs... Organize your house. We'll be in touch.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: wraith's destruction
fact: The wraith is destroyed when Calmer calls holy radiance for the third time, turning the chamber white.
source_quote: I had called the light one final time and it had answered. The chamber went white. The wraith came apart.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted Kelno’s deal to become the new leader of the Greater Temple by taking his network and resources.
source_quote: I tell them, just post some guards, to make sure no one enters the water temple. Just so we can conduct our business with the owner.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted the bugbears' order to be summoned, not to summon.
source_quote: They looked past me, counting heads. 'Where is the cleric?' 'I will summon him.' 'The cleric is in charge, of course.' 'Yes,' I said, and the useful lie settled into place the way it always does.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted the role of new ruler of the Upper Temple, despite having come to burn it.
source_quote: We came here to take this temple apart. We had become it instead.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr agreed to meet Barkinar, accepting the new power structure.
source_quote: We went down.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr drove Kelno's Dagger of Venom into Belsornig’s ribs.
source_quote: I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr heard the gong ring after Belsornig’s death and recognized it as the temple announcing a change of hands.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level. *Are they opening the door?* I asked, dagger still warm in my fist — but it wasn't a door. It was the temple announcing that something had changed hands.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr killed the second cultist with a blade to the expected spot.
source_quote: The second was mine. Surprise, for an assassin, is not an advantage. It is a sentence already finished before the man knows it started. The blade went in where it always goes. Automatic. Done.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr lied about being messengers for Kelno to gain entry.
source_quote: We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination, a letter, a coin to prove it. Zinnia produced the proof.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr lied to the bugbears that the cleric was hurt but would be fine.
source_quote: He's hurt. He will be fine.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr listened at the west door before attempting to enter.
source_quote: He put his ear to the door first, the way you do, listening for the thing on the other side before you give it a reason to listen back.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr offered meat to the bugbears to disrupt their certainty.
source_quote: Then Zephyr offered them meat. 'Are you hungry? Would you like some meat?'

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized Kelno had anticipated their rise and prepared the second chair weeks in advance.
source_quote: He knew we were a wild card he could leverage. The minute he saw what we did to Romag, the weakest of the four temples decided we might be the way he survives.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the party had already won the war by eliminating the other temple leaders and letting them destroy each other.
source_quote: We let Hartsch get killed. We let Romag get killed. We had a cleric pretending to be an earth cultist, which made us the fourth group, which meant the chair at the top was already ours — we just hadn't sat down.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the voice from the stairs as someone who knew the room and what happened in it.
source_quote: A voice came up from the stairs leading down. Unhurried. The voice of someone who had been in this room before and knew what happened in it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr referred to Kelno as 'the pimple' during their negotiation, revealing his crude, impulsive style.
source_quote: So — are you for or against? The pimple. My mouth tripped over the word and I let it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr was called 'puppet master' by the voice from the stairs.
source_quote: Puppet master. So they had watched the strings too, and named the hand that pulled them.

subject: Zephyr accepts Kelno's deal
fact: Zephyr accepts Kelno's offer and agrees not to kill him for the intelligence provided.
source_quote: I cut up the mercenaries," I said. "Yes, I'll take the deal. We won't kill you for his news.

subject: Zephyr's assassination
fact: Zephyr assassinated the second guard after the first was taken by Sequoia and Zinnia.
source_quote: The second was mine. Surprise, for an assassin, is not an advantage. It is a sentence already finished before the man knows it started.

subject: Zephyr’s Pact with Kelno
fact: Zephyr accepted Kelno’s offer to become his second-in-command, gaining access to his network of goblins, informants, and intelligence; in return, Kelno secured his survival by aligning with the rising power.
source_quote: His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine. His little office, his.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia drank in the chamber, reading the room before anything else.
source_quote: I drank it in. That is the job, before anything else: read the room.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed he had failed to see the hidden Greater Temple forces.
source_quote: *Gotcha.* Except this time the catch was on me. I had not seen them, and I am the one who sees. That stayed with me.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized the bugbears had converged from three directions, revealing they had always been watching.
source_quote: They came from the secret door we had left barred. They came from the eastern door. They came from the western door. Three approaches, converged at once, and the converging was the message: *we were always here, on every side of you, and you did not know.*

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized the door had shuddered and alerted the men inside.
source_quote: Behind the door, the two men went still, then loud. They'd felt it — the door shuddering, something heavy throwing itself at them twice and not getting through.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia remained silent when Barkinar spoke, recognizing silence as the only honest thing in the room.
source_quote: I said nothing. Silence has never cost me anything, and it was the only honest thing in the room.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia saw Kelno set beside him and filed Barkinar’s smile as significant.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tried to break down the west door twice and failed.
source_quote: I set myself, and I hit it. It didn't give. I bounced... I set again and hit it a second time, everything I had... and it threw me again.

subject: Belsornig’s People
fact: Belsornig’s faction has seized the Fire Temple’s treasury, moved it southward, and now threatens the Water Temple’s threshold. They are opportunists, not allies.
source_quote: Belsornig pulling his treasury out the south route.

subject: Bugbears of the Greater Temple
fact: Bugbears clad in the deeper black of the Greater Temple appeared without warning, enforcing Barkinar’s summons; they demonstrated surveillance capabilities and an ability to converge from multiple hidden entrances, indicating deep infiltration of the Upper Temple’s infrastructure.

subject: Bugbears of the Greater Temple
fact: The bugbears are the visible enforcers of the Greater Temple, wearing the deeper black of its authority. They operate with precision, speak in declarative truths, and use psychological misdirection — such as falsely assigning leadership to Calmer — to manipulate perceptions and extract compliance.
source_quote: They came from the secret door we had left barred. They came from the eastern door. They came from the western door. Three approaches, converged at once, and the converging was the message: *we were always here, on every side of you, and you did not know.*

subject: Dren's mercenaries
fact: Dren's mercenaries are a crude, loud, non-stealthy force hired to safeguard Calmer; they follow orders to remove him from danger but lack the tactical awareness to understand that their protection is undermining the mission's momentum.

subject: Dren's mercenaries
fact: Dren's mercenaries are described as non-stealthy, with clatter and loud breathing.
source_quote: The mercenaries are anything but stealthy, all clatter and breathing

subject: Dren's mercenaries
fact: Dren's mercenaries are tasked with protecting Calmer and preventing him from returning to the fight.
source_quote: because they had been told to keep the boss from getting himself killed.

subject: Greater Temple
fact: The Greater Temple operates as a hidden power structure beneath all other temple factions, with forces stationed on every level, including those the party believed were unoccupied. It manipulates events from the shadows, observes the party’s actions, and demands organizational control over the Upper Temple as a precondition for its continued non-violence.
source_quote: The Greater Temple had not kept its forces below. They had forces on this level, in the parts of the map we had never walked, sitting quiet behind brown marble while we ran our little war for them floor by floor.

subject: Greater Temple
fact: The Greater Temple operates covertly beneath the Upper Temple, having observed and manipulated the party’s campaign from the shadows; it now claims control of the conquered temples and demands organizational compliance within a week.

subject: Greater Temple
fact: The Greater Temple sends bugbears clad in deeper black to summon the intruders after the Water Temple takeover.
source_quote: Bugbears. A column of them, and the black they wore was not Earth Temple black — it was the deeper black, the black of the thing below the thing.

subject: Kelno’s Network
fact: Kelno’s network includes goblins, informants, bribery channels, and a ledger of payments to a dozen names. He controls access to the Water Temple and maintains a hidden surveillance apparatus. He has been preparing for the player group’s arrival for two weeks, setting out a second chair and waiting for them to claim their place.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names. And a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: Obsidian Edge
fact: The Obsidian Edge is a group despised by the Water Temple cultists as pompous asses, and is the target of internal sabotage and assassination.
source_quote: All that remains is for us to defeat those pompous asses known as the Obsidian Edge.

subject: The Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple bribed us to defect, then burned inward — its leadership now on a pyre, its treasury looted by Belsornig’s people.
source_quote: We took bribes from the Fire Temple, sold a chimera, knifed Romag at his own table, and pointed three armies at each other until they marched.

subject: The Four Lesser Temples
fact: The four lesser temples — Earth, Air, Fire, and Water — are competing factions whose leaders are being systematically eliminated through assassination, betrayal, and internal conflict orchestrated by Zephyr’s group; each has its own treasury, mercenaries, and methods of operation.
source_quote: The Fire Temple folding inward. Water Temple knives at the captain's threshold.

subject: The Four Starving Prophets
fact: The four starving prophets are chaotic, competing entities within the temple, each hungry for power; Zephyr views them as tools to be manipulated into self-destruction to clear the path to dominance.

subject: The Four Temples
fact: The Four Temples — Earth, Air, Water, and now the player group — are competing for dominance. The Earth Temple was the last winner of the previous competition. With Hartsch (Air) and Romag (Earth) dead, the player group has become the de facto fourth temple, claiming the chair at the top by default. Kelno, formerly aligned with Air, now seeks to transfer his allegiance to the group.
source_quote: We let Hartsch get killed. We let Romag get killed. We had a cleric pretending to be an earth cultist, which made us the fourth group, which meant the chair at the top was already ours — we just hadn't sat down.

subject: The Greater Temple
fact: The Greater Temple is the ruling body of the temple complex, whose leadership is determined by survival in a cycle of civil war; its doors open only after the lesser temples have fought to exhaustion, and the victor inherits control of all resources and informants.
source_quote: When the war ended, the great doors would open, and whoever stood on top of the upper temple became the Greater Temple's new partner.

subject: The Mercenary Corps
fact: The temple is filled with mercenaries who would sell each other for a copper if the war tilted. Dren is the only exception — he does not negotiate, he does not defect, he does not change sides.
source_quote: A temple full of mercenaries who would all sell us for a copper if the war tilted. He wouldn't.

subject: The Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is active, ancient, and sacred — its halls submerged in salt-tinged air, its altar offering coins and shells, its idol a writhing mass of sea creatures. It is not passive; it is watching.
source_quote: The whole chamber felt submerged. Like standing at the bottom of the sea.

subject: Upper Temple
fact: The Upper Temple is the faction the party intended to dismantle but has instead inherited and been forced to reorganize under the Greater Temple’s demands. It is now a shell of authority with leaderless cultists, unaccounted treasuries, and mercenary contracts requiring structure.
source_quote: We came here to take this temple apart. We had become it instead.

subject: Upper Temple
fact: The Upper Temple, once divided into sects (Fire, Water, Air, Earth), has been dismantled by the party; now under their de facto control, it must be restructured into a unified hierarchy under Barkinar’s oversight.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is a cult in civil conflict, with internal factions, cult fanatics guarding doors, and a prophet who reads scrolls while his guards are killed.
source_quote: A temple at war with itself... cult fanatics... a man who'd been reading a scroll.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple chamber contains gray carpet, gray plaster, gray hangings, two upholstered chairs, a crock half-full of mead, dull metal lamps, shelves with scrolls and foodstuffs, and human and demi-human skulls arranged on the shelves.
source_quote: Everything gray. Carpet, plaster, hangings, two upholstered chairs, a crock half-full of mead, lamps of dull metal throwing barely enough light to see by. And on the shelves between the scrolls and the foodstuffs — skulls. Human, demi-human, arranged like a man arranges things he's stopped thinking about.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple chamber has a narrow bed in the corner.
source_quote: A narrow bed in the corner.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple has stairs leading down to the Water Temple level.
source_quote: We turned for the stairs in the Air Temple, meaning to go home, to wash the water-stink off and report.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple is the next active zone of the dungeon, accessed via a northeast passage; it is currently occupied by four starving prophets and is the target of Zephyr's strategic assault to eliminate rivals and seize control.

subject: Air Temple stairs
fact: The stairs leading to the Air Temple were the intended escape route, but were blocked by the arrival of the Greater Temple's bugbears.
source_quote: We turned for the stairs in the Air Temple, meaning to go home...

subject: Air Temple Stairs
fact: The stairs leading up from the Water Temple to the Air Temple became the site of the Greater Temple’s ambush; the bugbears’ convergence from three directions revealed their prior occupation of the entire temple complex.

subject: Air Temple stairs
fact: The stairs of the Air Temple are the point of entry where the Greater Temple’s forces converged unexpectedly, revealing their omnipresence. The party had believed this area was secure — now it is marked as a site of deception and surveillance.
source_quote: We were at the foot of the stairs in the Air Temple, ready to climb back to our quarters, when they came up out of the dark in black.

subject: Barkinar’s Chamber
fact: A subterranean chamber beneath the Water Temple, fortified with ogres and a hill giant, designed to be inescapable; it is the seat of the Greater Temple’s authority and the place where the party’s fate was decided.

subject: Barkinar's chamber
fact: The chamber beneath the Upper Temple is fortified with a hill giant, ogres at the walls, and sealed exits, designed to prevent escape.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: Ceiling Leak
fact: A new drip has begun somewhere above the Water Temple hall — a change from the previous hour. It is not natural. It is a sign the temple is waking, or something is coming down.
source_quote: The dripping had started somewhere above us, in a ceiling that hadn't been dripping an hour ago. That's not good.

subject: Dren's holding area
fact: A hidden space behind a curtain or curtain-like barrier where Calmer is being carried and tended to by Dren's mercenaries; it is warm, safe, and detached from the mission's violence, symbolizing his emotional and strategic exile.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple has a secret door that was cracked open by gnolls weeks prior and was the group's intended destination.
source_quote: The secret door the gnolls had cracked open for us, the one we'd marked weeks ago

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is a section of the dungeon where the wraith was slain and the secret door was discovered weeks earlier by the party; it is now abandoned by the main group, with Calmer left behind in its aftermath.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is leaderless after the intruders' actions, according to Barkinar.
source_quote: Leaderless cultists in the Fire Temple.

subject: Greater Temple command chamber
fact: Barkinar's command chamber was located below the Upper Temple, accessible via hidden stairs, and fortified for control.
source_quote: We went down. The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out.

subject: Greater Temple entrance
fact: The Greater Temple's hidden forces occupy unseen areas of the Upper Temple, revealed by the arrival of black-clad bugbears.
source_quote: They came from the secret door we had left barred. They came from the eastern door. They came from the western door.

subject: Greater Temple hidden passages
fact: The Greater Temple maintained hidden passages and observers throughout the Upper Temple, unseen until revealed by the bugbears.
source_quote: They had forces on this level, in the parts of the map we had never walked, sitting quiet behind brown marble while we ran our little war for them floor by floor.

subject: Hidden passages of the Greater Temple
fact: The hidden passages allow the Greater Temple to observe, move, and strike without detection. The party’s entire campaign has been conducted under their gaze, and these passages are the conduit through which they manipulate events, personnel, and perceptions.
source_quote: He has been watching from hidden passages for two weeks.

subject: Lower Chamber of the Greater Temple
fact: The lower chamber is a trap room designed to ensure no one escapes after confrontation. It contains a hill giant, ogres, and controlled access — a physical manifestation of the Greater Temple’s absolute authority and its method of enforcing compliance through overwhelming force.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out.

subject: temple stairs
fact: The temple stairs are made of brown marble with black veins, and Calmer's heels drag across them as he is carried.
source_quote: my heels dragging across the brown stone with its black veins

subject: The Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple is Kelno’s stronghold, a gray, lifeless chamber filled with skulls, mead, and scrolls; it serves as the site of Zephyr’s pivotal alliance and the last place Calmer was conscious before being removed.
source_quote: The room the color of old ash... skulls. Human, demi-human, arranged like a man arranges things he's stopped thinking about.

subject: The Upper Temple
fact: The Upper Temple is the seat of ultimate authority among the four temples. Whoever stands atop it after a conflict becomes the new partner of the Greater Temple. The group now occupies this position by default, though they have not yet formally claimed it.
source_quote: Whoever's on top leads the lesser temples.

subject: The Upper Temple
fact: The Upper Temple is the seat of ultimate authority, whose doors only open after the lesser temples have fought to exhaustion; its control is the prize Zephyr seeks, and its threshold is where Calmer was dragged away from, symbolizing his exclusion from power.
source_quote: Whoever stood on top of the upper temple became the Greater Temple's new partner.

subject: The Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is lightly guarded at present, making it the ideal target for the group’s next move. Kelno has directed the group to strike there, and the group has agreed to secure it without killing him — using his knowledge and network to consolidate control.
source_quote: He pointed us toward the Water Temple — lightly guarded now, he observed, as good a time as any to strike.

subject: The Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is the next target of Zephyr’s group, now lightly guarded after the collapse of the Fire Temple; it represents the final obstacle to total control of the temple complex and the next stage of their ascent.
source_quote: He pointed us toward the Water Temple — lightly guarded now, he observed, as good a time as any to strike.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple hall contains a great sheet of bronze set into the west wall, covered in verdigris.
source_quote: Bronze everywhere, all of it gone to verdigris, that green crust that says nobody has touched this in a long time, or nobody dares. A great sheet of bronze set into the west wall.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple hall has a ceiling arched and lost in shadow high overhead, walls of polished blue-swirled-deep-green stone, and a soft cloudy luminosity bleeding from the stone.
source_quote: We came up on the Water Temple and the corridor opened into a hall the size of a barracks, the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead. The walls were slabs of polished stone, blue swirled into deep green, and some old magic had been laid into them — a soft, cloudy luminosity that bled out of the stone and floated in the damp air

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple hall has a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind the idol.
source_quote: with a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple hall has an alcove south of the altar containing an idol of serpentine stone shaped as a knot of fish, eels, and octopi.
source_quote: South of it, in the mouth of an alcove, an idol of serpentine stone: a writhing knot of fish and eels and octopi sculpted into one horrid mass

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple hall has an altar near the middle, round and squat, with a concave top holding a shallow basin of water.
source_quote: An altar near the middle of the hall, round and squat, its concave top holding a shallow basin of water

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple hall has four triangular plinths in the corners, each topped with a bronze gargoyle covered in verdigris.
source_quote: In each corner a triangular plinth ran up toward the vaulted dark, and atop each one a bronze gargoyle squatted under its coat of green.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple has trolls on contract, according to Barkinar.
source_quote: Trolls on contract in the Water Temple.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is a place of damp stone, old water, bronze doors, and marble thresholds, where cultists guard inner chambers and prophets read scrolls in isolation.
source_quote: smelling of damp stone and old water... bronze... brown marble... He'd been reading a scroll.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is lightly guarded and identified by Kelno as a good target for attack.
source_quote: He pointed us toward the Water Temple — lightly guarded now, he observed, as good a time as any to strike.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple, once a sanctum of Belsornig, is now a conquered ruin; its altar, gargoyle-plinths, and offering basin remain intact, but its cultists are dead and its leadership extinguished.

subject: Water Temple alcove
fact: The alcove in the Water Temple held the serpentine idol and was the focal point of the offering.
source_quote: South of it, in the mouth of an alcove, an idol of serpentine stone...

subject: Water Temple altar
fact: The altar in the Water Temple's hall held a round, squat basin of water, where offerings were placed.
source_quote: An altar near the middle of the hall, round and squat, its concave top holding a shallow basin of water...

subject: Water Temple altar basin
fact: The altar basin in the Water Temple held a shallow layer of water with coins, gems, and seashells.
source_quote: a shallow basin of water, and at the bottom of the basin — coins, a scatter of gems, seashells.

subject: Water Temple ceiling
fact: The ceiling of the Water Temple was arched and lost in shadow, contributing to the submerged atmosphere.
source_quote: the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: Water Temple ceiling shadow
fact: The ceiling of the Water Temple was lost in shadow, enhancing the feeling of being submerged.
source_quote: the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: Water Temple corridor
fact: The corridor of the Water Temple opened into a hall the size of a barracks, with arched ceiling lost in shadow.
source_quote: We came up on the Water Temple and the corridor opened into a hall the size of a barracks, the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: Water Temple corridor entrance
fact: The Water Temple corridor opened into a hall, with the ceiling lost in shadow and the walls covered in luminous stone.
source_quote: We came up on the Water Temple and the corridor opened into a hall the size of a barracks, the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: Water Temple entrance alcove
fact: The Water Temple's entrance alcove held the serpentine idol and was the focal point of the offering.
source_quote: South of it, in the mouth of an alcove, an idol of serpentine stone...

subject: Water Temple Hall
fact: The Water Temple hall is a vast, submerged-feeling chamber with blue-green swirled stone walls, luminous mist, salt-tinged air, and a central altar holding an offering of coins and shells. It is ancient, sacred, and silent — and it remembers every step.
source_quote: The ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead... the whole chamber felt submerged.

subject: Water Temple hall
fact: The Water Temple's hall was large, with polished blue stone slabs, blue-swirled into deep green, and a soft luminosity.
source_quote: The walls were slabs of polished stone, blue swirled into deep green, and some old magic had been laid into them — a soft, cloudy luminosity...

subject: Water Temple inner sanctum
fact: The inner sanctum of the Water Temple was reached silently after the assassination of Belsornig and his guards.
source_quote: We crossed the chamber like the floor owed us silence — and it gave it, every footfall swallowed, not a breath out of place.

subject: west door
fact: The west door is a heavy, stubborn barrier of bronze or wood, located at the far eastern end of the temple, and was the chosen point of entry due to its fewer rooms beyond.
source_quote: The west door... the west door — fewer rooms, fewer surprises... the door held and threw me back.

subject: west door of Water Temple
fact: The west door of the Water Temple was the chosen entry point due to fewer rooms and lower risk.
source_quote: The west door. Always the west door — fewer rooms, fewer surprises, fewer chances for a war zone to introduce me to something it had been saving.

subject: Barkinar count
fact: Barkinar is the leader of the Greater Temple, who observes, manipulates, and demands order from the Upper Temple.
source_quote: Barkinar brought Calmer with him, half-carried... He gave us the inventory of our new holdings...

subject: bronze gargoyle
fact: Four bronze gargoyles squat atop triangular plinths in the corners of the Water Temple hall and are observed as potential watchers.
source_quote: In each corner a triangular plinth ran up toward the vaulted dark, and atop each one a bronze gargoyle squatted under its coat of green. Four watchers in the corners.

subject: Bronze Gargoyles
fact: Four bronze gargoyles squat atop triangular plinths in each corner of the Water Temple hall, coated in verdigris. They are inert but ancient — their stillness is a warning, not a sign of weakness.
source_quote: In each corner a triangular plinth ran up toward the vaulted dark, and atop each one a bronze gargoyle squatted under its coat of green.

subject: bugbear count
fact: A column of black-clad bugbears from the Greater Temple arrived to summon the new rulers of the Upper Temple.
source_quote: Bugbears. A column of them, and the black they wore was not Earth Temple black — it was the deeper black, the black of the thing below the thing.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four watchers in the corners

subject: conjured force blades
fact: Two cultists wielded blades of conjured force that hovered in the air, ready to strike — but were neutralized before they could activate.
source_quote: blades of conjured force already hanging in the air, hovering, ready for trouble.

subject: cult fanatics
fact: Two cult fanatics with blades of conjured force are present behind the west door of the Water Temple.
source_quote: They were cult fanatics, and not entirely stupid: blades of conjured force already hanging in the air, hovering, ready for trouble.

subject: Falrinth count
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.
source_quote: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.

subject: gnoll
fact: A gnoll was charred and its smell had been hanging in the corridors all morning.
source_quote: Somewhere south of us the smell of charred gnoll had been hanging in the corridors all morning

subject: hill giant
fact: A hill giant is present in the lower chamber where Barkinar meets the intruders.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: Hill Giant
fact: A hill giant stood as a silent enforcer in Barkinar’s chamber, part of a lethal deterrent designed to prevent escape and ensure compliance during the summons.

subject: hill giant count
fact: A hill giant was stationed in Barkinar's chamber as a deterrent to rebellion.
source_quote: A hill giant.

subject: Kelno’s Goblins
fact: Kelno’s goblins are his primary enforcers and scouts, part of his bribery and surveillance network. They are now being offered to the player group as part of the partnership — their loyalty shifting from Kelno to the group as the new power.
source_quote: His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine.

subject: ogre count
fact: Ogres were stationed at the walls of Barkinar's chamber as enforcers.
source_quote: Ogres at the walls.

subject: ogres
fact: Ogres stand at the walls of the lower chamber where Barkinar meets the intruders.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: Ogres
fact: Ogres were stationed along the walls of Barkinar’s chamber, forming a physical barrier and psychological intimidation tactic to reinforce the Greater Temple’s dominance and the party’s helplessness.

subject: Senshock count
fact: Senshock, the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, is ambitious, paranoid, and useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Serpentine Idol
fact: The idol in the alcove is a horrid knot of fish, eels, and octopi sculpted into one mass, taller than a man, draped in seaweed. It is not mere art — it is the temple’s god, and it is aware.
source_quote: An idol of serpentine stone: a writhing knot of fish and eels and octopi sculpted into one horrid mass... with a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind.

subject: The Assassins
fact: Assassins hired to kill Hartsch were instructed to avoid the player group, indicating the group has become a recognized, untouchable force even among enemies. Their presence confirms the scale of the power struggle and the group’s unintended status as a wildcard.
source_quote: Even the man trying to murder our puppet had given orders to leave us breathing.

subject: The Wraith
fact: The wraith was a spectral entity that resisted divine power, laughing at Calmer’s holy radiance until it was destroyed; its defeat cost Calmer dearly and marked the beginning of his physical and spiritual decline.
source_quote: Twice the holy radiance had hit the wraith and simply ceased — the way divine light ceases when it finds nothing that recognizes it.

subject: wraith
fact: Calmer killed a wraith twice with holy radiance before finally destroying it on the third attempt.
source_quote: Twice it had laughed at the holy power I called down in His name. Twice the holy radiance had hit the wraith and simply ceased — ... and twice I had felt the outrage of it — ... I had called the light one final time and it had answered. The chamber went white. The wraith came apart.

subject: Wraith
fact: The wraith was a spectral entity of divine corruption that resisted holy power until Calmer's repeated invocation of radiance shattered it; it laughed at divine authority and was the first major supernatural threat overcome in the temple.

subject: Alrrem
fact: Alrrem is already on his pyre when Dren reports to Sequoia.
source_quote: Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar brings Calmer with him, half-carried, when meeting the intruders in the lower chamber.
source_quote: Barkinar brought Calmer with him, half-carried, assuming — as everyone assumed — that the cleric was the chief of us.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar considers Senshock ambitious and paranoid but useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar is the enforcer of the Greater Temple who has observed the party’s actions from hidden passages for two weeks, knows more than he reveals, and has eliminated four named threats with precision. He demands organizational order in the Upper Temple within a week and holds leverage over the party through their assumed hierarchy and hidden knowledge.
source_quote: Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig... four problems gone by sundown. You will forgive me if I'm impressed.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar is the leader of the Greater Temple who summons the intruders after they take the Water Temple.
source_quote: One of them announced, gruff and flat, that Barkinar wished to speak to the new rulers of the Upper Temple.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar lists Romag, Hartsch, Alrrem, and Belsornig as problems eliminated by the intruders.
source_quote: "Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig," Barkinar said. "Problems I had on a list yesterday morning, and four problems gone by sundown."

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar refers to Calmer as a 'puppet master' when speaking from the stairs.
source_quote: "That was efficient. Come down, bring your puppet master if he is alive. We should talk."

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar smiles at Kelno when he sees him held captive in the lower chamber.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar, representative of the Greater Temple, summoned the party after the fall of the Upper Temple, revealing he had observed their entire campaign from hidden vantage points and now demands they organize the conquered temple under his authority within a week.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is identified by the cultists as the Prophet of Water and the target of the intruders.
source_quote: News for the big boss. News for Belsornig.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is reading a scroll when the intruders enter the chamber.
source_quote: He never turned... He'd been reading a scroll.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is targeted by an assassination plot and is pulling his treasury out via the south route.
source_quote: Belsornig — *by the cannon of the crushing wave*, the man liked the name — the assassination plot against Hartsch... ... Belsornig pulling his treasury out the south route.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is the Prophet of Water, preoccupied with a scroll when infiltrators breached his temple, and was killed without ever fully registering the threat.
source_quote: Belsornig, Prophet of Water, was preoccupied... He swayed. One more hit and there'd be nothing left to question.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig, Prophet of Water, was preoccupied with a scroll when the party infiltrated his sanctum; he was killed swiftly by Zephyr using Kelno’s Dagger of Venom, unaware of the breach until it was too late.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig, the Prophet of Water, is killed by Zephyr using the Dagger of Venom.
source_quote: I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home. The Prophet of Water folded onto his own wet floor.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes he is the boss and should lead, but is being carried away from the fight.
source_quote: I am the boss. Yes, I am. And the boss does not run from evil. But they carried me anyway...

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric who cannot utter his god's name in the temple, resulting in his prayers manifesting as complaints and despair; he was severely injured after slaying a wraith with divine radiance and is now being carried away from the battlefield by Dren's mercenaries, deemed too vulnerable to continue fighting.
source_quote: I am the boss. Yes, I am. And the boss does not run from evil. But they carried me anyway...

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a figure of safety — possibly a prisoner, ally, or asset — who remains upstairs, unharmed. His presence suggests the group has secured key personnel, and his safety is a sign of their growing control over the environment.
source_quote: Calmer was upstairs. Safe. Or as safe as anything in here.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is believed by the Greater Temple to be the cleric and chief of the intruders, though he is injured.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course." and "He's hurt. He will be fine.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is carried up the stairs by Dren's mercenaries after being severely injured in the fight against the wraith.
source_quote: The man was being carried. Hands had me. Many hands, rough hands, the wrong hands — Dren's people, hauling me up off the marble by the arms and the plate, my heels dragging across the brown stone with its black veins, my mace knocking against someone's shin.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is described as a cleric who cannot say his god's name in the temple, causing his prayers to come out as complaints.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't a worrier. He just couldn't say his own god's name in here, so it came out sideways, as complaint.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is placed upstairs under the care of Dren's mercenaries to prevent him from re-entering the fight.
source_quote: Deeply injured, parked with Dren's mercenaries somewhere behind a curtain so he wouldn't get himself killed reaching for a god he can't name in here.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the boss, severely injured and being carried away from the battlefield by Dren's mercenaries, convinced he is being protected but is in fact being removed from the fight; he believes he is losing his relevance and is haunted by a cold presence in his chest that whispers doubt and detachment.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the cleric who has been mistakenly perceived by the Greater Temple and its agents as the leader of the party, though he is injured and not in command. His perceived authority is a deliberate misreading exploited by the party as leverage.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the injured cleric who cannot speak his god’s name in this place — it comes out as complaint. He is helpless, unable to run, and the only man in the temple whose vulnerability is tied to sacred silence.
source_quote: He just couldn't say his own god's name in here, so it came out sideways, as complaint.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer, the cleric, was presumed by Barkinar and the bugbears to be the leader of the party; Zephyr lied that he was injured but would recover, allowing the group to maintain the illusion of his authority while concealing their true command structure.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren carries Calmer up two flights of brown marble stairs after the battle with the wraith.
source_quote: Dren had carried him up two flights of brown marble and the thanks he wanted was to be heard out about it.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is a mercenary captain who remains loyal to Zephyr and his team despite the treacherous environment; he carries out orders without question and is entrusted with guarding Calmer, the only person in the temple whose loyalty cannot be bought.
source_quote: You didn't put me in charge of mercenaries, because I tell you what to do.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is a subordinate who has already completed the task the group requested — descending the corridor while they ascended, proving he understands their timing and authority. He views Kelno as a nuisance, reinforcing the group’s rising dominance.
source_quote: Oh my god," he said, "that guy whines a lot." A pause. "He won't shut up.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is instructed to stay behind with Calmer and guard him with his mercenaries.
source_quote: "Take your mercenaries and stay back," Zephyr landed on, finally.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the leader of the mercenaries hired to protect Calmer; his people are tasked with keeping Calmer alive but are unaware that their actions are effectively sidelining the true leader of the mission.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the only loyal man in the temple — he follows only us, refuses mercenary deals, and acts on truth rather than coin. He is not a mercenary in the room’s sense; he is the blade that points our direction and means it.
source_quote: He didn't take orders, except from us, and that was the whole point of him.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the only mercenary who consistently follows Calmer and Zephyr’s orders without betrayal.
source_quote: He wouldn't. I didn't know why. Maybe it was the negotiation. Maybe he just liked having someone tell him the truth about what he was for. Either way he was the only blade in this entire stone box that pointed our direction and meant it.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren reports that Belsornig's people are at the captain's door and that Alrrem is on his pyre.
source_quote: "The captain, the captain? March is finished." Dren said it fast, the way men say things they ran to deliver. "Belsornig's people are at his door. He's screaming for you." ... "Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren says 'okay, boss' before the infiltration of the Water Temple begins.
source_quote: Dren said "okay, boss," and that was the last easy thing.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren states that he was not put in charge of mercenaries and that he only follows orders.
source_quote: "You didn't put me in charge of mercenaries, because I tell you what to do." He shrugged, a soldier's shrug. "You tell me."

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a rogue wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons unknown; Barkinar mentioned him as a potential future contact, hinting at deeper fractures within the temple hierarchy.

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.
source_quote: A second name, set down lighter, for later: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a wizard in hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own. Barkinar mentions him as a potential future point of discussion, suggesting he is a wildcard with undisclosed significance to the temple’s internal politics.
source_quote: We could talk about Falrinth later.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is assassinated by agents who reached his antechamber an hour prior to the meeting with Kelno.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno admits his guards are the worst in the dungeon and that he could easily be killed.
source_quote: I could kill him — worst guards in the dungeon, he admitted it himself — and then walk into the deep temple blind...

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno gave Zephyr the Dagger of Venom and requested he use it to kill Belsornig.
source_quote: "I've been saving this to kill Belsornig for some time. If you wouldn't mind doing me the honors?"... I'd taken his deal... "Well, I'll give it to you. Take it," I'd said

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is a cunning, aged operative who has survived by aligning with shifting power structures. He acknowledges chaos and appetite over loyalty, and has been waiting two weeks for the player group to become the fourth temple — positioning himself as a viable partner. He controls informants, goblins, and a network of bribery, and has secretly set out a second chair in anticipation of their arrival.
source_quote: He smiled and gave me nothing. Loyalty to the power of air, he said, the way a man swears loyalty to weather.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is a mysterious figure who gifted the Dagger of Venom to the infiltrator, requesting it be used to kill Belsornig, and is aligned with chaos but also with the value of living.
source_quote: The Dagger of Venom. Kelno's gift... I'd taken his deal in seconds because his answer had been honest — for chaos, but also for living.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is a prisoner held by the Greater Temple, placed beside the party during their meeting with Barkinar. His presence and Barkinar’s smile at him indicate Kelno has been under observation and possibly complicit or compromised, making him a key to hidden loyalties.
source_quote: Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that. A man who smiles at the prisoner he has been watching from hidden passages for two weeks is a man who already knows more than he is saying.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is an elderly, cunning prophet of air who has survived multiple temple wars by aligning with the strongest faction; he offers Zephyr control of his intelligence network in exchange for partnership, revealing he anticipated the war and prepared the second chair for Zephyr weeks in advance.
source_quote: I've noted for a week... You are going to be the one.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is an old cultist who offers Zephyr a deal to become his number two and take control of his goblins and informants.
source_quote: Or I could walk out with him as my number two. His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine. His little office, his.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is held captive in the lower chamber beneath the Water Temple and is set beside Zinnia by Barkinar's orders.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno keeps a ledger detailing payments to a dozen names and a note saying "set out the second chair," placed two weeks prior.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names. And a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno values survival over loyalty and seeks to remain alive by aligning with the strongest faction.
source_quote: Yes, I am for chaos, but I'm also for living.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno, a prisoner of the Greater Temple, was brought before Barkinar; he had previously given Zephyr the Dagger of Venom to kill Belsornig, indicating a personal grudge and alignment with chaos — a bond Zephyr respected.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag was killed at his own table by the group's prior actions.
source_quote: We took bribes from the Fire Temple, sold a chimera, knifed Romag at his own table, and pointed three armies at each other until they marched.

subject: Senshock
fact: Senshock is the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple — ambitious, paranoid, and useful. Barkinar advises the party to be civil to him and let him underestimate them, indicating he is a dangerous but manipulable variable in the temple’s power structure.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful. Be civil, and let him underestimate you.

subject: Senshock
fact: Senshock is the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, described as ambitious and paranoid but useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Senshock
fact: Senshock, the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, is described by Barkinar as ambitious, paranoid, and useful — a dangerous figure the party must appease by letting him underestimate them.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia declares that the group are the victors after realizing they have manipulated the temple war.
source_quote: "We are the victors," Sequoia said.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a blunt, observant member of Zephyr’s inner circle who voices the group’s cynical realism; he recognizes the power dynamics of the temple war and affirms their position as the inevitable victors through calculated inaction and exploitation.
source_quote: We are the victors.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a silent, efficient operative aligned with Zephyr, moving with him and Zinnia into the Air Temple; she represents the disciplined force that executes the mission while Calmer is incapacitated and removed.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is the de facto leader of the player group, known for terse communication and strategic patience. He recognizes the group’s unclaimed dominance after the deaths of Hartsch and Romag, and has accepted Kelno’s partnership — not out of trust, but because it serves their expanding operation. He is the one who initiates the deal and frames their rise as inevitable victory.
source_quote: We are the victors," Sequoia said. And he was right, and that was the thing I'd been circling without letting myself touch.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is the silent observer who confirms decisions with minimal words. His 'Yep' ends debate. He is not a strategist — he is the anchor of consensus.
source_quote: Sequoia agreed in a word — 'Yep' — and that settled it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia provided quick-witted cover during the infiltration, offering the lie 'Housekeeping!' when the door was breached, and later participated in the takedown of Belsornig’s guards, then killed the final cultist after Zephyr’s strike.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia responds to Kelno's offer by saying, "We sit there silently and menacingly," and is acknowledged for the menace.
source_quote: "Yeah," Sequoia said. "We sit there silently and menacingly." He appreciated the menace.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia responds to Zinnia's door failure with the word "Yep" to agree not to take treasure.
source_quote: Sequoia agreed in a word — "Yep" — and that settled it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia shouts "Housekeeping!" as a bluff when the cultists behind the door question the intruders.
source_quote: Sequoia, without missing a beat: "Housekeeping!"

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia supported Zinnia's failed breach, offered a clumsy cover story ('Housekeeping!'), and later killed the second cultist after Zinnia struck the first blow.
source_quote: Sequoia, without missing a beat: 'Housekeeping!'... Sequoia opened him up. Sequoia stepped over the body and ended the rest of it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asks Kelno if he is for or against 'the pimple,' referring to the current power structure.
source_quote: "Kelno," I said. "So — are you for or against? The pimple." My mouth tripped over the word and I let it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr claims to be a messenger for Kelno when the cultists behind the door demand identification.
source_quote: I tried Kelno — "We are messengers for Kelno"

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr claims to be bearing news for Belsornig to deceive the cultists behind the door.
source_quote: News for the big boss. News for Belsornig.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr fumbles the suggestion to leave Dren with Kelno, then corrects himself upon remembering Calmer is upstairs.
source_quote: You could stay here with — what's his name. Kelno." Then he caught himself. Calmer was upstairs. We took him up. "Oh. Shit."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a pragmatic, ruthless leader who manipulates factions into civil war to seize control of the Greater Temple; he brokers a deal with Kelno, accepts his intelligence network and goblins, and strategically removes Calmer from combat to preserve his own operational autonomy.
source_quote: We are the victors... This is starting to be a very lucrative operation.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is an assassin who believes surprise is a sentence already finished before the target knows it started, and who chose the west door for its fewer rooms and lower risk of detection.
source_quote: Zephyr wanted the west — fewer rooms to cross, less chance of stumbling into something.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is an assassin who shifted tactics from forced entry to deception, successfully bluffing the cultists into opening the west door by posing as messengers bearing news of Belsornig’s assassination, then eliminating both guards with precision.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is the de facto leader of the party, pragmatic and ruthless, who orchestrated Calmer's removal from the front lines to ensure mission continuity; he leads the group into the Air Temple with Zinnia and Sequoia, and has no qualms about letting the starving prophets turn on each other to secure dominance.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is the strategist who calculates corpse value, route efficiency, and tactical risk with grim precision. He is not a leader — he is the math behind the decision, and he knows it.
source_quote: He's better at the math when there's more than one prize in the room.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr leads the group into the Air Temple after Calmer is removed from the party.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't with us. ... I had the others. And I had the only thing in this temple that ever told me the truth: four starving prophets...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr listens at the west door of the Water Temple before the infiltration attempt.
source_quote: Zephyr put his ear to the door first, the way you do, listening for the thing on the other side before you give it a reason to listen back.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr respects Kelno as an honest man with a poisoned knife and a grudge.
source_quote: An honest man with a poisoned knife and a grudge. I respected all three.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr says 'Let's go export' when entering the Air Temple, a phrase nobody corrects.
source_quote: "Let's go export," I said, which is not how the word goes, but nobody corrected me, and we went.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr trusts Kelno because he recognizes his honest hunger to survive, not false loyalty.
source_quote: That was the genuine article. Not loyalty — appetite, the clean honest hunger of a man who only wants to wake up tomorrow. I respect that. I trust it more than I'd ever trust a vow.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia attempted to breach the west door with force, bounced back twice, and later provided false credentials as messengers for Kelno before revealing a forged letter of assassination as proof.
source_quote: Zinnia hit the door and the door hit back... Zinnia produced the proof.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia attempts to break down the west door of the Water Temple by shoulder-ramming it twice.
source_quote: I set myself, and I hit it. It didn't give. I bounced... I set again and hit it a second time, everything I had... and it threw me again.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes the bronze everywhere had been untouched for a long time, or nobody dares.
source_quote: Bronze everywhere, all of it gone to verdigris, that green crust that says nobody has touched this in a long time, or nobody dares.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia expresses suspicion toward Kelno during the negotiation in the Air Temple.
source_quote: "We have to be suspicious of him," Zinnia said.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is one of Zephyr's trusted lieutenants, quiet and lethal, following him into the Air Temple with Sequoia; she is part of the core team that enters the active combat zone while Calmer is sidelined.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is perceptive and skeptical, the one who identifies the weak point in any arrangement — the place where something is already going to give. She challenges Kelno’s motives and forces the group to confront the moral ambiguity of their rise, serving as the group’s moral compass.
source_quote: She was right. She has a way of finding the part of a thing that doesn't hold — the place where it was already going to give.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is the infiltrator tasked with breaching barriers, but failed twice to break the west door of the Water Temple, revealing a critical vulnerability in their plan and drawing attention from the cultists inside.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realizes the Greater Temple had forces on this level all along, hidden in plain sight.
source_quote: I knew. The Greater Temple had not kept its forces below. They had forces on this level, in the parts of the map we had never walked, sitting quiet behind brown marble while we ran our little war for them floor by floor.

subject: Altar Basin
fact: The altar basin holds a shallow pool of water, filled with scattered coins, gems, and seashells — an offering left by the faithful or the desperate. Touching it would be sacrilege.
source_quote: Its concave top holding a shallow basin of water, and at the bottom of the basin — coins, a scatter of gems, seashells.

subject: basin of water
fact: The basin on the altar contains a scatter of coins, gems, and seashells as offerings.
source_quote: at the bottom of the basin — coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: bronze gargoyle value
fact: Bronze gargoyles, covered in verdigris, sat atop triangular plinths in the Water Temple's chamber.
source_quote: In each corner a triangular plinth ran up toward the vaulted dark, and atop each one a bronze gargoyle squatted under its coat of green.

subject: bronze sheet value
fact: A great sheet of bronze, covered in verdigris, was set into the west wall of the Water Temple.
source_quote: A great sheet of bronze set into the west wall.

subject: Calmer's mace
